name: agentic-memory
description: Layered project memory for coding agents: project overview (L1), key map (L2), facts with full change history (L3) and raw events (L4), plus a global directory of people and teams. Connects over MCP HTTP to a hosted service or a local Docker stack.

mcp_url.title: MCP URL
mcp_url.description: Keep the default to run the service locally with Docker (/agentic-memory:setup starts it). For a hosted service use its https URL ending in /mcp.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: MEMORY_API_KEY of the service. Local mode: /agentic-memory:setup creates one in ~/.agentic-memory/.env.
